|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Lieutenant Grond (V)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB3-10-Lieutenant_Grond-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 3 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Lieutenant Grond (V)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Lieutenant Grond (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 3 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “[Pilot] 2. Adds one battle destiny with Colonel Dyer or if driving a swoop. May place Lieutenant Grond in Used Pile to cancel a Force drain at a related location.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf Virtual Block 3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174313/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Lieutenant Grond (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “destiny with” to “destiny if with” and writes the [Pilot] icon out as “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots”: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Adds one battle destiny if with Colonel Dyer or if driving a swoop. May place Lieutenant Grond in Used Pile to cancel a Force drain at a related location.”.<ref name="cl-1230_10-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142208/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
